niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers interfaces that feel airy, clean, and premium rather than busy or loud. They like light or very dark restrained backgrounds depending on context, but always with strong visual simplicity, generous spacing, and clear hierarchy. They favor direct, concise copy over conversational or ambiguous wording, and they respond well to prominent blue or navy primary actions. They also prefer interfaces that are either highly structured and information-rich when task-oriented, or very minimal and isolated when shown as a modal. Across screens, they tend to like rounded cards, centered or clearly separated compositions, and subdued but polished visual styling over playful, crowded, or highly urgent-looking designs.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers layouts with generous spacing, fewer visible elements, and an airy composition rather than dense, crowded screens.
Prefers either clean light surfaces or very dark restrained surfaces, but in both cases wants the interface to feel uncluttered and visually controlled.
Prefers short, direct, status-based or action-oriented copy over softer, more conversational, ambiguous, or overly explanatory text.
Prefers clear, prominent primary actions, especially blue or navy filled buttons, with obvious call-to-action visibility.
Prefers content organized into rounded cards or clearly separated sections with strong hierarchy and clean grouping.
Prefers subdued, premium color palettes with controlled accents; avoids overly saturated, playful, or alarmist color treatments unless the context is explicitly warning-related.
When the screen is a functional list or management view, prefers visible details, clear item-level actions, and structured information rather than empty or minimal placeholders.
